name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v534: Fixed the remaining cloudflare failures on Android TV and the 2-3 repeated solves on phones. (1) The bypass WebView now opens at app open again: plugin.load receives the Application context, so the old code had no Activity and silently skipped - it now waits for CloudStream's foreground Activity. (2) The pre-solve cookie purge was removed: setCookie deletions are queued and could land after Cloudflare wrote the new token, deleting the first successful solve; the solver now remembers the old token and only accepts a different one. (3) cf_clearance from challenges.cloudflare.com/cloudflare.com is no longer merged into the saved AnimePahe cookie, which previously produced 'Saved' cookies that yielded no streams. (4) AnimePahe requests that hit a challenge now always use this plugin's bypass (forced, site-root target) instead of a racing CloudflareKiller whose init wipes the shared cookie jar; in-flight solves and throttling are keyed by site, not exact URL. All prior features retained: real cookie validation, invisible-by-default real-sized solver, visible fallback, no buttons.
